failures.impact: Nonmaterial single official page unavailable; targeted official-disruption searches and California WIC agency page were accessible. This was not a comprehensive agency scan.

observations: California WIC official federal-budget notice says WIC services remain available under a continuing resolution; last updated in September 2026 and no new interruption.
Northern News Now reported the new Lincoln Park grocery store opening in Duluth on November 9, 2026; improved access, not a closure.
South Plains Food Bank published planned Veterans Day and Thanksgiving holiday closures; routine preannounced holiday schedule, not an emergency disruption.
Third-party SNAP outage report page gave no evidence of an official in-window interruption; latest content can differ by crawl, so it was not treated as an authoritative clearance.
KVIA El Paso food-bank storm closure occurred September 25, 2026; out of current interval.

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Excluded donation drives, resource directories, recipes, opinions, promotion, generic inflation, routine holiday closures, old incidents, and duplicates. No in-window incident confirmed.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was substantiated by 12 targeted searches and available direct-source checks. Search recall is not exhaustive; one official SNAP updates URL was inaccessible.
